Candidate set · checked 2026-11-12

Chinese AI models to evaluate

These eight sourced candidates cover different sizes, licenses, modalities, and deployment modes. Their order is not an absolute ranking.

  1. Qwen3-8B — An Apache-2.0 hybrid thinking model. Official source
  2. Qwen3.8-27B — An Apache-2.0 vision-language model with 262K native context. Official source
  3. Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B — A large Qwen reasoning model under the Qwen3.8-Max license. Official source
  4. GLM-5 — An MIT-licensed model for coding and long-horizon agents. Official source
  5. DeepSeek-V3.2 — An open-weight reasoning model for agents and tool use. Official source
  6. Kimi K2.5 — An open-weight multimodal agent model. Official source
  7. MiniMax M2.1 — An open-weight model for coding and agent workflows. Official source
  8. Qwen3.5-397B-A17B — an additional officially documented candidate; view its Pairvu model profile. Official source
